entries.text: Write Primitives on SQLite now runs the MERGE, DDL, INSERT-batch, TRUNCATE and date-arithmetic operations (emulated with UPDATE/INSERT, DELETE FROM and sqlite_master checks), skips the file bulk-load and sketch operations with a recorded reason instead of failing them, restores staging tables correctly on reset, and no longer rescans the full TPC-H source tables before every operation, shortening large-scale runs.
